## High-impact review

Check every applicable item:

- [ ] Legal force, effective date, commencement, repeal, supersession, precedent, or controlling relationship
- [ ] Source rights, licence, attribution, or redistribution
- [ ] Privacy, anonymisation, removal, tombstone, or restoration
- [ ] Coverage or completeness representation
- [ ] Charter, governance, contribution, rights, privacy, or security policy
- [ ] None of the above

High-impact changes require two qualified human approvals under `GOVERNANCE.md`. The author and automated agents cannot count as either approval.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] I cited the primary official evidence available to me and identified uncertainty or known gaps.
- [ ] I kept source material separate from unofficial transcription, metadata, translation, and summary.
- [ ] I did not include a user's legal situation, unnecessary personal data, sealed material, credentials, or other secrets.
- [ ] I recorded the source-specific rights basis; I did not assume that MIT covers third-party official documents.
- [ ] I preserved append-only correction history, or explained the privacy, security, or legal reason for restriction.
- [ ] I identified affected derivatives. If authenticated lifecycle receipts are enabled, I verified invalidation and rebuild before `APPLIED`; base V1 must leave that state disabled.
- [ ] I disclosed any material conflict of interest.
- [ ] I signed my commits under the Developer Certificate of Origin.
- [ ] I disclosed below if an automated agent generated or materially transformed this contribution, and a person checked the result.
